strings: !This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
XRepresents a DWM (Desktop Window Manager) thumbnail that creates a mirror of any window.
bA value that determine whether the window shown in the DWM thumbnail should maintain aspect ratio.
hA value that determine whether the window shown in the DWM thumbnail should display its non-client area.
YA value that determine the offsets of X and Y coordinates when drawing the DWM thumbnail.
